text:
alicia_sales: Hey team — large enterprise POC (FinCo) wants a 6-month Dedicated commit with autoscaling + 2x burst. They asked for a single blended committed rate rather than base+burst. Can we price/approve? Details: 16 A100s reserved, burst up to 32 for 4h/day. Target discount ~25% vs list. Need proposal by EOD.

ben_eng: Quick note on billing: burst is charged at 'on-demand' per-minute for overage except when you pre-approve burst credits. For commit pricing we normally quote base commit @ reserved rate + a burst premium. If they want blended, we need to convert expected burst-hours into equivalent committed-GPU-months.

ben_eng: Example calc:
```
reserved = 16 GPUs * 24h * 30d = 11520 GPU-hours/mo
burst_extra = (32-16) GPUs * 4h/day * 30d = 1920 GPU-hours/mo
effective_commit = (reserved + burst_extra) / (24*30) ≈ 24 GPUs
```
Quote = price_per_gpu_reserved * 24 * months (apply commit discount tier)

dinesh_salesops: @alicia_sales please confirm: are burst hours deterministic (same 4h/day) for their POC or variable? For approvals, we need expected monthly spend and proposed discount %.

alicia_sales: It's pretty deterministic for POC week schedule, but might ramp. Customer wants a single unit price to simplify procurement.

carol_accounts: If they're asking for blended pricing we need a one-time amendment in contract and a new invoice schedule. Also need to confirm net-30 vs net-45.

eve_prod: Heads-up: in eu-west-1 we have limited spare capacity for A100s in April; suggest adding mixed-GPU fallback (8xA100 + 16xA40) in the routing policy to avoid throttles during burst.

alicia_sales: Good point @eve_prod — include fallback note. For discounts: customer asking 25% off list for committed baseline. What thresholds trigger auto-approval?

dinesh_salesops: Our deal desk auto-approves up to 15% for new commits under $250k ARR. Anything >15% or >$250k needs finance + VP sales sign-off. Also, recurring discount caps differ for POC vs committed production.

alicia_sales: @approval-bot can you route this with the docs? Attach: expected_monthly_spend= $360k, proposed_discount=25%, term=6 months.

approval-bot: Routing to finance_review queue. Auto-check: discount 25% > auto-approve threshold. Manager approval required: @frank_finance.

frank_finance: Reviewed. We can approve a one-time 20% blended credit for the 6-month POC (to cover churn risk) but not a recurring 25% list discount. Recommend 20% recurring for first 3 months then re-evaluate performance-based. Approve if sales accepts amendment language and fallback routing.

alicia_sales: Thanks @frank_finance — I'll update the SOW to propose 20% recurring for 3 months + 1x 10% onboarding credit. Pulling legal for contract note.

carol_accounts: I'll prepare amendment template and set billing net-30. Please attach PO once signed.

alicia_sales: Will do. Thanks all :pray:
